analyst.summary: Metropolis Healthcare, India's second-largest diagnostics chain, has had a historically modest growth record but posted a genuine acceleration this past year - revenue growth picked up to the mid-20s% and profit grew even faster, reflecting real margin improvement rather than an acquisition or a one-off. The balance sheet is conservatively run and debt is low. The main question is whether this last year is the start of a new, faster growth phase or a good year within an otherwise steady, moderate-growth business - at roughly 64 times earnings, the market is already leaning toward the former. We rate this a Hold.
